summary: No European platform publishes an explicit 'we run your box office for X%' package. Evidence falls into four patterns: (1) service bundled into a high-single-digit percentage or custom quote (Ticket Fairy 8-10% incl. account manager; DICE 8.5% + 2.5%; GoOut/Ticketportal about 8% + 3.5% buyer; Spektrix undisclosed revenue-linked service charge); (2) per-ticket managed tier with itemised scope (ThunderTix White Glove USD 1.95 vs USD 1.25 reserved); (3) a-la-carte hourly/one-off services on top of a low base commission (smsticket 5% + published extras; Vivetix 2% + EUR 0.10 + EUR 21/h staff, EUR 60/day PDA; pretix hardware list); (4) service as a perk of volume or paid-event status (Eventbrite Sales Partnerships, Billetto Growth 1,000+ tickets, Weeztix success manager, Weezevent project manager).
support_is_free_baseline: Human support is free at: Ticket Tailor (24/7, 5-minute target), TicketSource (phone + chat + email), Ludus (7 days), TryBooking (phone/email), Humanitix, Fienta, pretix (phone, Mon-Fri), Weezevent (24/7 + free on-call during events), Little Box Office (7 days). What is NOT free: seating chart creation (ThunderTix USD 0.55 per seat min USD 250; smsticket from 1,250 CZK), PDF ticket design (smsticket 500-1,000 CZK), white label (Ticket Tailor about GBP 39/month, custom domain GBP 7/month - third party), on-site staff (smsticket 600 CZK/h, Vivetix EUR 21/h), scanner hardware (Weezevent EUR 90/day, pretix EUR 95 per 3 days, Vivetix EUR 60/day, smsticket 250 CZK per reader), marketing campaigns (smsticket SMS 1.50-3 CZK, FB/IG campaign 3,000 CZK prep).

general_service_pricing_context: White-glove event management is commonly priced as 15-25% of total event budget (Snapsight glossary) - this is event production, not ticketing, so it is only a ceiling reference: https://www.snapsight.com/en/resources/glossary/white-glove-services/ (snippet)
Gevme and ClearEvent articles say account managers, on-site crew and live onboarding usually add cost but publish no numbers: https://www.gevme.com/en/blog/event-management-software-pricing/
implication_for_1_eur_per_ticket_hypothe: A published managed tier premium exists only at ThunderTix (+USD 0.70/ticket plus monthly floor) which is the nearest analogue to the hypothesised EUR 1. Percentage models that bundle an account manager (Ticket Fairy 8-10%, PLG about 8%) are far above EUR 1 on tickets over EUR 12. Service that most competitors give free: human support, scanner app, self-service seating. Service that is monetised: design done for you, seat map build, on-site staff/hardware, white label, campaigns.
gaps: Not found: public managed-service percentage from any European box-office outsourcing agency; Eventer prices; Entradium official pricing page; DICE partner service scope; Humanitix hours; ticket-design pricing for most platforms; Ticket Tailor white-label price on an official page. Bright Data returned empty for several JS-heavy sites; some figures are from competitor or aggregator pages (flagged third_party).
